title: CAD tolerance stack-up bounds (cad-fits stackup.py, legacy and intent stack files)
description: The numeric bounds of a stack file; stackup.py checks its structure. The contributor tolerances are magnitudes in mm. Hard bounds are errors; x-plausible bands are warnings (plausibility.<field>)

coverage_factor.description: k of a justified RSS. The default 2 follows the GUM convention (JCGM 100:2008, ISO/IEC Guide 98-3, section 6.3.3): k = 2 gives about 95 percent coverage for a normal distribution. stackup.py still requires an explicit k with an approving decision, so the default is the loader's starting value
